name: TXC Corporation
summary: TXC Corporation engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of crystal units and oscillator products in Taiwan and internationally. It offers ThermSym OCXO, TCXO, MHz XO, kHZ XO, Controlled Crystal Oscillators (VCXO), Temperature Sensing Crystal (TSX), MHz Crystal, and kHz Crystal. Its products are used in various applications, including telecom and enterprise, automotive, consumer electronics, and mobile communication. TXC Corporation was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Taoyuan city, Taiwan.
